l-e-h3-b02-01.title: Ị pụrụ iji catch kama get?
l-e-h3-b02-01.goal: Tụlee ma nkwupụta na nkebiokwu nwere get na-ada ka ọ dị okike mgbe agbanwere ha ka ha bụrụ catch bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, wee chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-h3-b02-01.material: Nkwupụta: Nkebiokwu nwere get na-ada ka ọ dị okike mgbe niile ma ọ bụrụ na ị tinye catch n'ọnọdụ get. Chọta nnọchi nke na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-h3-b02-01.s.s1.r.a: Abụọ na-ada ka ha dị okike. Nke a bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h3-b02-01.s.s1.r.b: Abụọ na-ada ka ha dị okike. Nke a bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-h3-b02-01.s.s1.explain: Ịgbanwe get a letter (inweta akwụkwọ ozi) ka ọ bụrụ catch a letter na-ada ka ihe ịtụnanya. A na-eji catch na pairs e debere dị ka cold, bus, na flu.

l-e-h3-b02-02.title: Ọ bụrụ na nzọụkwụ ọ bụla bụ imperative, ntụziaka ọ̀ doro anya?
l-e-h3-b02-02.goal: Tụlee ma nkwupụta na ntụziaka doro anya ma ọ bụrụ na nzọụkwụ ọ bụla bụ imperative bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, wee chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-h3-b02-02.material: Nkwupụta: Ọ bụrụ na nzọụkwụ ọ bụla nke ntụziaka bụ imperative (na-amalite na verb), ha bụ ntụziaka doro anya nke dị mfe ịgbaso. Chọta nzọụkwụ nke na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-h3-b02-02.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nzọụkwụ bụ imperative mana siri ike ịgbaso?
l-e-h3-b02-02.s.s1.r.a: Oge doro anya, ya mere ị pụrụ ịgbaso ya.
l-e-h3-b02-02.s.s1.r.b: Ọ doro anya ihe a ga-ebute.
l-e-h3-b02-02.s.s1.r.d: Ọnụọgụ doro anya, ya mere ị pụrụ ịgbaso ya.
l-e-h3-b02-02.s.s1.explain: Add some of it to the thing. bụ imperative, mana ị maghị ihe it na the thing bụ ma ọ bụ ole ị ga-agbakwunye.
l-e-h3-b02-02.s.s2.model.0: Add some of it to the thing. bụ imperative, mana ị nweghị ike ịmata ihe ị ga-agbakwunye ma ọ bụ ole, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ ezighị ezi.
l-e-h3-b02-02.s.s2.model.1: Ọbụna ma ọ na-amalite na verb, it na the thing adịghị doo anya, ya mere ọ siri ike ịgbaso, nke na-eme ya ihe atụ megidere.

l-e-h3-b02-03.goal: Tụlee ma nkwupụta na either nwere ike ịga ebe ọ bụla n'ahịrịokwu either ... or bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, wee chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-h3-b02-03.material: Nkwupụta: N'ahịrịokwu either ... or, ọ ziri ezi ebe ọ bụla ị tinyere either. Chọta ahịrịokwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-h3-b02-03.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ahịrịokwu na-emegide nkwupụta ahụ (bụ ihe atụ megidere)?
l-e-h3-b02-03.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ ahịrịokwu parallel ziri ezi.
l-e-h3-b02-03.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ ahịrịokwu parallel ziri ezi.
l-e-h3-b02-03.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ ahịrịokwu parallel ziri ezi.
l-e-h3-b02-03.s.s1.explain: Either she is tired or hungry. na-ejikọ she is tired (clause) na hungry (adjective) site na or, ya mere ọ bụghị parallel.
l-e-h3-b02-03.s.s2.model.0: she is tired bụ clause ma hungry bụ adjective, ya mere akụkụ abụọ e jikọtara site na or nwere udi dị iche nkwupụta ahụ ezighịkwa ezi.
l-e-h3-b02-03.s.s2.model.1: Ọnọdụ either ga-akwekọrịrị ihe na-abịa mgbe or, ya mere ahịrịokwu a, nke na-ejikọ clause na adjective, bụ ihe atụ megidere.

l-e-h3-b02-04.title: Aha ọ̀ bụ isi ihe mgbe niile?
l-e-h3-b02-04.goal: Tụlee ma nkwupụta na aha na-ekwu isi ihe nke ederede mgbe niile ọ̀ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọtakwa ma kọwaa ikpe ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-h3-b02-04.material: Nkwupụta: Aha ederede na-ekwu isi ihe nke ederede ahụ ozugbo mgbe niile. Aha bụ "Red Sky" ederede ahụ bụkwa "Farmers long watched the evening sky to predict weather. A red sunset often means dry weather tomorrow."
l-e-h3-b02-04.s.s1.prompt: Gịnị mere ederede a ji bụrụ ihe atụ megidere nkwupụta ahụ?
l-e-h3-b02-04.s.s1.r.a: Ịdị mkpụmkpụ anaghị eme ya ihe atụ megidere.
l-e-h3-b02-04.s.s1.o.b: N'ihi na ahụ ederede enweghị isi ihe
l-e-h3-b02-04.s.s1.o.c: N'ihi na aha na-ekwu ozugbo isi ihe na agba mbara igwe na-agwa gị ihu igwe
l-e-h3-b02-04.s.s1.o.d: N'ihi na aha na-enye naanị isiokwu ma isi ihe dị n'ahụ ederede
l-e-h3-b02-04.s.s1.explain: Red Sky na-agwa naanị isiokwu. Ị ghaghị ịgụ ederede ahụ iji mata isi echiche: iche ihu igwe site n'agba mbara igwe.
l-e-h3-b02-04.s.s2.model.0: Red Sky na-akpọ naanị isiokwu, isi echiche dịkwa n'ederede, ya mere aha anaghị ekwu isi echiche mgbe niile.
l-e-h3-b02-04.s.s2.model.1: Aha anaghị ekwu ihe ọ bụla gbasara iche ihu igwe, ya mere ị ghaghị ịgụ ederede ahụ iji chọta isi echiche, nkwupụta ahụ ezighịkwa ezi.

l-e-h3-b02-05.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-ada ka oyi. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h3-b02-05.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-ada ka oyi. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-h3-b04-01.title: Heavy ọ̀ na-aga na noun ọ bụla?
l-e-h3-b04-01.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "heavy na-aga n'ụzọ dị okike na noun ọ bụla" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere), ma kọwaa ya.
l-e-h3-b04-01.material: Nkwupụta: Heavy, pụtara "ọtụtụ" ma ọ bụ "dị njọ," na-ada ka ọ dị okike tupu noun ọ bụla. Chọta okwu nke na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-h3-b04-01.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ pair dị okike a na-eji mgbe okporo ụzọ jupụtara. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h3-b04-01.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ pair dị okike a na-eji mgbe mmiri na-ezo ọtụtụ. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h3-b04-01.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ pair dị okike a na-eji mgbe snow na-ada ọtụtụ. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h3-b04-01.s.s1.explain: Okpomọkụ na-ejikọta na high, ọ bụghị heavy (high temperature). Noun ọ bụla nwere adjectives e debere nke na-aga na ya.
l-e-h3-b04-01.s.s2.model.0: Heavy temperature na-ada ka ihe ịtụnanya ma ọ ga-abụrịrị high temperature, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ ezighị ezi.

l-e-h3-b04-02.material: Nkwupụta: Ọ bụrụ na enweghị okwu njikọ (so, but, wdg) n'etiti ahịrịokwu abụọ, ahịrịokwu abụọ ahụ anaghị ejikọta n'ụzọ dị okike. Chọta ahịrịokwu abụọ nke na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-h3-b04-02.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrịokwu abụọ nke na-emegide nkwupụta ahụ (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-h3-b04-02.s.s1.r.a: Enweghị okwu njikọ ma ọdịnaya anaghị ejikọtakwa. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h3-b04-02.s.s1.r.c: Enweghị okwu njikọ ma ọdịnaya anaghị ejikọtakwa. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h3-b04-02.s.s1.r.d: Enweghị okwu njikọ ma ọdịnaya anaghị ejikọtakwa. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h3-b04-02.s.s1.explain: N'I missed the bus. I was late., nke mbụ bụ ihe kpatara ma nke abụọ bụ nsonaazụ, ya mere ha na-ejikọta n'ụzọ dị okike ọbụna n'enweghị okwu njikọ.
l-e-h3-b04-02.s.s2.model.0: Ọbụna n'enweghị okwu njikọ, ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ (ịhapụ bus, ya mere ịbịa ọ gafere oge) na-ejikọta, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ ezighị ezi.
l-e-h3-b04-02.s.s2.model.1: Ọdịnaya nke ahịrịokwu abụọ ahụ na-ejikọta ibe ha, ya mere ọ na-ada ka ọ dị okike ọbụna n'enweghị okwu njikọ.

l-e-h3-b04-03.title: Ihe ọ bụla ọ̀ pụrụ ịbịa mgbe and, n'udi ọ bụla?
l-e-h3-b04-03.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "ihe e jikọtara site na and nwere ike inwe udi dị iche" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere), ma kọwaa ya.
l-e-h3-b04-03.material: Nkwupụta: Mgbe e jikọtara omume atọ site na and, ahịrịokwu ahụ nwere grammar ziri ezi ọbụna ma ihe ndị ahụ nwere udi dị iche. Chọta ahịrịokwu nke na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-h3-b04-03.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrịokwu nke na-emegide nkwupụta ahụ (grammar adịghị mma).
l-e-h3-b04-03.s.s1.r.a: Ihe atọ niile dị n'udi -ing, ya mere ọ na-ada ka ọ dị okike. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h3-b04-03.s.s1.r.c: Ihe atọ niile dị n'udi to + verb, ya mere ọ na-ada ka ọ dị okike. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h3-b04-03.s.s1.r.d: Ihe atọ niile dị n'udi mbụ nke verb, ya mere ọ na-ada ka ọ dị okike. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h3-b04-03.s.s1.explain: Running na cooking bụ -ing, mana naanị nke ikpeazụ bụ to sing, ya mere parallel structure na-agbaji. Udi nke ihe ndị ahụ ga-adabarịrị.
l-e-h3-b04-03.s.s2.model.0: Running, cooking, na to sing e jikọtara site na and nwere udi dị iche ma na-ada ka ihe ịtụnanya, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ ezighị ezi.
l-e-h3-b04-03.s.s2.model.1: Ihe dị n'ndepụta ga-enwerịrị otu udi, ya mere ọ ezighị ezi ma ọ bụrụ naanị nke ikpeazụ bụ to sing.

l-e-h3-b04-04.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "ahịrịokwu nwere akara ịtụnanya nwere ụda iwe" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere), ma kọwaa ya.
l-e-h3-b04-04.material: Nkwupụta: Ahịrịokwu nke na-agwụ na akara ịtụnanya (!) nwere ụda iwe mgbe niile. Chọta ahịrịokwu nke na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-h3-b04-04.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ ụda iti mkpu n'iwe. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h3-b04-04.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ ụda iwe na-agwa onye ka ọ ghara igbochi ụzọ. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h3-b04-04.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ ụda nkụda mmụọ na iwe. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h3-b04-04.s.s1.explain: Thank you ... gift! nwere akara ịtụnanya, mana ụda bụ nke obi ụtọ na ekele. Akara ịtụnanya na-egosi naanị ike nke mmetụta.

l-e-h3-b04-05.title: Nchịkọta ọ̀ ga-agụnye ọnụọgụ?
l-e-h3-b04-05.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "nchịkọta dị mma na-agụnye ọnụọgụ mgbe niile" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere), ma kọwaa ya.
l-e-h3-b04-05.material: Nke mbụ: In one study, students who slept eight hours recalled more words than those who slept four. Nkwupụta: Nchịkọta dị mma na-agụnye ọnụọgụ dị n'ederede mgbe niile. Chọta ihe atụ megidere.
l-e-h3-b04-05.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ nke bụ nchịkọta dị mma ọbụna n'enweghị ọnụọgụ (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-h3-b04-05.s.s1.r.a: Ọ nweghị ọnụọgụ ma ọ nweghị ihe ọ metụtara ederede, ya mere ọ bụghị nchịkọta dị mma.
l-e-h3-b04-05.s.s1.r.b: Ọ nweghị ọnụọgụ, mana ọ na-efu isi ihe, ya mere ọ bụghị nchịkọta dị mma.
l-e-h3-b04-05.s.s1.r.c: Ọ gụnyere ọnụọgụ (eight-hour). Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h3-b04-05.s.s1.explain: More sleep helps memory. bụ nchịkọta na-ejide isi ihe nke ederede (ụra na ebe nchekwa) ọbụna n'enweghị ọnụọgụ.

l-e-h3-b05-04.material: Nke mbụ: Nkịta, nwamba, na hamsters chọrọ nri, mmiri, na nlebara anya. Echiche: Nchịkọta ọma agaghị eji okwu na-adịghị n’ederede mbụ. Chọta ihe atụ megidere ya.

l-e-h3-b06-01.title: Ịgbakwunye -ly ọ̀ na-eme ihe ọ pụtara dị nso?
l-e-h3-b06-01.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta na adverb e mere site n'ịgbakwunye -ly na adjective nwere ihe ọ pụtara dị nso ọ̀ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọtakwa ma kọwaa ikpe ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-h3-b06-01.material: Nkwupụta: Adverb e mere site n'ịgbakwunye -ly na adjective nwere ihe ọ pụtara dị nso na adjective mbụ. Chọta ụzọ abụọ na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-h3-b06-01.s.s1.r.a: 'quick' na 'quickly' nwere ihe ha pụtara dị nso. Nke a bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h3-b06-01.s.s1.r.b: 'slow' na 'slowly' nwere ihe ha pụtara dị nso. Nke a bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h3-b06-01.s.s1.r.c: 'careful' na 'carefully' nwere ihe ha pụtara dị nso. Nke a bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h3-b06-01.s.s1.explain: hard pụtara 'siri ike, na-arụsi ọrụ ike,' mana hardly pụtara 'fọrọ nke nta ka ọ ghara.' E nwere ụzọ abụọ ebe ịgbakwunye -ly anaghị edebe ihe ọ pụtara dị nso.
l-e-h3-b06-01.s.s2.model.0: hardly, nke e mere site n'ịgbakwunye -ly na hard, pụtara fọrọ nke nta ka ọ ghara, ya mere ihe ọ pụtara adịghị nso, nkwupụta ahụ ezighịkwa ezi.
l-e-h3-b06-01.s.s2.model.1: hardly nwere ihe ọ pụtara dị iche na hard, ya mere ọbụlagodi na a gbakwunyere -ly ihe ọ pụtara adịghị nso, nkwupụta ahụ ezighịkwa ezi.

l-e-h3-b06-02.title: Ịgbanwe usoro ahịrịokwu ọ̀ na-agbanwe ihe ọ pụtara mgbe niile?
l-e-h3-b06-02.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta na ịgbanwe usoro ahịrịokwu abụọ na-agbanwe ihe ọ pụtara ọ̀ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọtakwa ma kọwaa ikpe ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-h3-b06-02.material: Nkwupụta: Ọ bụrụ na ị gbanwe usoro ahịrịokwu abụọ jikọtara, ihe ọ pụtara na-agbanwe mgbe niile. Chọta ahịrịokwu abụọ na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-h3-b06-02.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrịokwu abụọ nke ihe ha pụtara na-anọgide otu ọbụlagodi na e gbanwere usoro (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-h3-b06-02.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụrụ na e gbanwee usoro, usoro ihe mere na-agbanwe. Nke a bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h3-b06-02.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụrụ na e gbanwee usoro, usoro ihe mere na-agbanwe. Nke a bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h3-b06-02.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụrụ na e gbanwee usoro, ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ na-agbanwe. Nke a bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h3-b06-02.s.s1.explain: Ahịrịokwu abụọ na-akọwa kichin na ogige n'iche n'iche na-edebe otu ihe ọ pụtara ọbụlagodi na e gbanwee usoro, n'ihi na enweghị usoro oge ma ọ bụ ihe kpatara.
l-e-h3-b06-02.s.s2.model.0: A na-akọwa kichin na ogige iche iche, ya mere ihe ọ pụtara bụ otu ọbụna ma a gbanwee usoro, nke pụtara na nkwupụta ahụ adịghị mma.
l-e-h3-b06-02.s.s2.model.1: Ahịrị okwu na-enweghị usoro oge ma ọ bụ ihe kpatara na-edebe otu ihe ọ pụtara mgbe a gbanwere, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ adịghị mma.

l-e-h3-b06-03.title: Ngwaa n'either A or B na-ekwekọ na A mgbe niile?
l-e-h3-b06-03.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta na ngwaa maka isiokwu either A or B na-ekwekọ na A bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, wee chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-h3-b06-03.material: Nkwupụta: Mgbe either A or B bụ isiokwu, ngwaa na-ekwekọ na A mgbe niile. Chọta ahịrị okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-h3-b06-03.s.s1.r.a: A na B abụọ bụ otu, ya mere ngwaa bụkwa otu. Nke a bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h3-b06-03.s.s1.r.d: A na B abụọ bụ otu, ya mere ngwaa bụkwa otu. Nke a bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h3-b06-03.s.s1.r.c: A na B abụọ bụ ọtụtụ, ya mere ngwaa bụkwa ọtụtụ. Nke a bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h3-b06-03.s.s1.explain: N'either A or B, ngwaa na-ekwekọ na B nke dị nso. Ọbụna ma book bụ otu, pens bụ ọtụtụ, ya mere jiri are.
l-e-h3-b06-03.s.s2.model.0: Ngwaa are na-ekwekọ na B nke dị nso, pens, ọ bụghị na A, book, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ adịghị mma.
l-e-h3-b06-03.s.s2.model.1: N'either A or B, ngwaa na-ekwekọ na B, ya mere ikwu na ọ na-ekwekọ na A mgbe niile adịghị mma.

l-e-h3-b06-04.title: Nchịkọta ga-eso usoro nke mbụ?
l-e-h3-b06-04.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta na nchịkọta ọma na-eso usoro nke mbụ kpọmkwem bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, wee chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-h3-b06-04.material: Nke mbụ: The bakery opened in 2019. It now has five shops. Its first shop was a tiny stall. Nkwupụta: Nchịkọta ọma ga-eso usoro nke mbụ. Chọta ihe atụ megidere.
l-e-h3-b06-04.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nchịkọta ọma anaghị eso usoro nke mbụ?
l-e-h3-b06-04.s.s1.r.b: Ọ nwere naanị otu ozi, ya mere enweghị nsogbu usoro, ma ọ ezughị dị ka nchịkọta.
l-e-h3-b06-04.s.s1.r.c: Ọ nwere naanị otu ozi, ya mere enweghị nsogbu usoro, ma ọ ezughị dị ka nchịkọta.
l-e-h3-b06-04.s.s1.r.d: Nchịkọta a e dere n'usoro nke mbụ. Ọ bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h3-b06-04.s.s1.explain: Ọ na-etinye ozi ikpeazụ, na ụlọ ahịa mbụ bụ obere ụlọ ahịa, n'ihu kpamkpam ma na-ahazi ya dị ka akụkọ uto. Ọbụna na a gbanwere usoro, ọ bụ nchịkọta ọma.
l-e-h3-b06-04.s.s2.model.0: Ọbụna ma ọ na-etinye ọdịnaya ikpeazụ, obere ụlọ ahịa, nke mbụ wee duga n'ụlọ ahịa ise, ọ na-ejide isi okwu, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ adịghị mma.
l-e-h3-b06-04.s.s2.model.1: Ahịrị okwu na-agbanwe usoro ma na-ahazi ya dị ka akụkọ uto na-ejidekwa isi okwu, ya mere ikwu na ị ga-eso usoro adịghị mma.

l-e-h3-b06-05.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta na ahịrị okwu nwere not bụ nleba anya njọ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, wee chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-h3-b06-05.material: Nkwupụta: Ahịrị okwu nwere okwu mmegide not bụ nleba anya njọ mgbe niile. Chọta ahịrị okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-h3-b06-05.s.s1.r.a: Ọ nwere not ma bụrụ nleba anya njọ n'ezie. Nke a bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h3-b06-05.s.s1.r.c: Ọ nwere not ma bụrụ nleba anya na-ekwu nkụda mmụọ. Nke a bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-h3-b07-01.title: Strong na powerful ọ̀ bụ ndị a pụrụ ịgbanwe mgbe niile?
l-e-h3-b07-01.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta na strong na powerful nwere ike ịgbanwe tupu noun ọ bụla bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, wee chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ naghị adị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-h3-b07-01.material: Nkwupụta: strong na powerful nwere ike ịgbanwe tupu noun ọ bụla. Chọta pair nwere okwu agbanwere nke na-ada ka ihe na-adịghị okike ma gbajie nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h3-b07-01.s.s1.r.a: strong engine dịkwa okike. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h3-b07-01.s.s1.r.c: strong speech dịkwa okike. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h3-b07-01.s.s1.r.d: powerful argument dịkwa okike. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h3-b07-01.s.s1.explain: strong coffee bụ pair dị okike, mana powerful coffee na-ada ka ihe ịtụnanya. Okwu abụọ ahụ na-aga na nouns dị iche.
l-e-h3-b07-01.s.s2.model.0: powerful coffee bụ okwu ịtụnanya, ya mere nkwupụta na ha nwere ike ịgbanwe tupu noun ọ bụla ezighị ezi.
l-e-h3-b07-01.s.s2.model.1: strong coffee dị okike, mana ịgbanwe ya na powerful na-eme ka ọ dị ka ihe ịtụnanya, ya mere pair a bụ ihe atụ megidere nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-h3-b01-06.title: Kedu ihe ngosi a chọrọ iji kpebie usoro?
l-e-h3-b01-06.goal: Họpụta ọkwa (ozi) a chọrọ kpamkpam iji chọpụta usoro nke ahịrịokwu ntụziaka agwakọtara, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ị ji họrọ ya.
l-e-h3-b01-06.material: A gwakọtara ahịrịokwu nke ntụziaka isi nri: "Add the eggs." "Before that, melt the butter." "Finally, serve warm." Họpụta ihe ngosi a chọrọ kpamkpam iji kpebie usoro.
l-e-h3-b01-06.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ihe ngosi a chọrọ kpamkpam iji kpebie usoro?
l-e-h3-b01-06.s.s1.r.a: Ọnụọgụ okwu enweghị ihe ọ gbasara usoro.
l-e-h3-b01-06.s.s1.r.b: Ahịrịokwu niile nwere ya, ya mere ọ naghị agwa gị usoro.
l-e-h3-b01-06.s.s1.o.c: Ugboro ole butter na eggs na-apụta
l-e-h3-b01-06.s.s1.r.c: Ugboro ole ihe ndị ahụ na-apụta enweghị ihe ọ gbasara usoro.
l-e-h3-b01-06.s.s1.o.d: Ihe okwu usoro dịka Before that na Finally pụtara
l-e-h3-b01-06.s.s1.explain: Before that pụtara tupu omume gara aga, Finally pụtakwa ikpeazụ. Ihe okwu usoro pụtara bụ ihe ngosi maka ikpebi usoro.
l-e-h3-b01-06.s.s2.model.0: Before that na Finally bụ okwu na-egosi usoro, ya mere ị ghaghị ịmara ihe ha pụtara iji kpebie usoro.
l-e-h3-b01-06.s.s2.model.1: Ogologo ahịrịokwu na periods niile dị ihe dị ka otu, ya mere ị ghaghị ilele okwu na-ekwu mbụ na ikpeazụ iji nweta usoro.

l-e-h3-b01-07.title: Kedu ọkwa maka ikpebi ma ndepụta ọ̀ bụ parallel?
l-e-h3-b01-07.goal: Họpụta ọkwa (ozi) a chọrọ kpamkpam iji kpebie ma ihe ndị dị n'ndepụta bụ parallel, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ị ji họrọ ya.
l-e-h3-b01-07.material: E nwere ahịrịokwu na-edepụta ihe, dịka "I like ___, ___, and ___." Ị chọrọ ịchọpụta ma ihe ndị ahụ bụ parallel (nwee otu udi).
l-e-h3-b01-07.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọkwa a chọrọ kpamkpam iji kpebie ma ha bụ parallel?
l-e-h3-b01-07.s.s1.o.a: Ma ihe ọ pụtara nke ihe ndị ahụ dị otu
l-e-h3-b01-07.s.s1.r.a: Ọbụlagodi na ihe ha pụtara dị otu, ha abụghị parallel ma ọ bụrụ na udi ha dị iche.
l-e-h3-b01-07.s.s1.o.b: Ma ihe ndị ahụ nwere otu ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede
l-e-h3-b01-07.s.s1.r.b: Ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede enweghị ihe ọ gbasara ịbụ parallel.
l-e-h3-b01-07.s.s1.o.c: Ma udi ụtọasụsụ nke ihe ndị ahụ bụ otu
l-e-h3-b01-07.s.s1.o.d: Ma ihe ndị ahụ dị n'usoro mkpụrụedemede
l-e-h3-b01-07.s.s1.r.d: Usoro enweghị ihe ọ gbasara ịbụ parallel.
l-e-h3-b01-07.s.s1.explain: Parallel pụtara na udi ụtọasụsụ nke ihe ndị ahụ (-ing, to-infinitive, na ndị ọzọ) bụ otu. Ihe ọ pụtara na ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede abụghị ọkwa.
l-e-h3-b01-07.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na udi dị iche, dịka swimming na to hike, ha abụghị parallel ọbụlagodi na ihe ha pụtara dị otu, ya mere ị ghaghị ilele udi ụtọasụsụ.
l-e-h3-b01-07.s.s2.model.1: Ịbụ parallel pụtara ime ka udi kwekọọ, ya mere ma ọ bụ -ing na -ing na to-infinitive na to-infinitive bụ ọkwa a chọrọ.

l-e-h3-b01-08.title: Kedu ọkwa maka ihe ga-aga n'nchịkọta?
l-e-h3-b01-08.goal: Họpụta ọkwa (ozi) a chọrọ kpamkpam iji kpebie ihe ga-aga n'nchịkọta, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ị ji họrọ ya.
l-e-h3-b01-08.material: Ederede: "Green roofs, covered with plants, keep buildings cooler in summer. They also soak up rain, so streets flood less. One roof in Oslo even hosts a small beehive."
l-e-h3-b01-08.s.s1.prompt: Kedu bụ ụkpụrụ maka ịhọrọ ọdịnaya mgbe a na-achịkọta ederede a?
l-e-h3-b01-08.s.s1.r.a: Inwe aha ebe anaghị eme ya isi echiche.
l-e-h3-b01-08.s.s1.o.b: Ma ọ bụ isi echiche nke ederede na ihe kpatara ya
l-e-h3-b01-08.s.s1.o.c: Ma ọ dị n'ahịrịokwu kacha ogologo
l-e-h3-b01-08.s.s1.r.c: Ogologo enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na mkpa.
l-e-h3-b01-08.s.s1.o.d: Ma ọ bụ nkọwa kacha eju anya
l-e-h3-b01-08.s.s1.r.d: Ụlọ ngwere na-eju anya, ma ọ bụghị isi echiche.
l-e-h3-b01-08.s.s1.explain: Nchịkọta na-agụnye isi echiche (uru nke green roofs), ma enwere ike ịhapụ nkọwa dị ka ụlọ ngwere dị n'Oslo.
l-e-h3-b01-08.s.s2.model.0: Isi okwu bụ na green roofs na-eme ka ụlọ dị jụụ ma belata iju mmiri, ya mere ị nwere ike ịhọrọ site n'ụkpụrụ ahụ.
l-e-h3-b01-08.s.s2.model.1: Ụlọ ngwere bụ nkọwa, ya mere ụkpụrụ nke itinye naanị isi echiche na ihe kpatara ya bụ nke ziri ezi maka nchịkọta.

l-e-h3-b01-09.title: Gịnị na-ekpebi ụda?
l-e-h3-b01-09.goal: Họrọ ụkpụrụ (ozi) nke achọrọ n'ezie iji kpee ụda nke ederede, ma kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-e-h3-b01-09.material: Ederede abụọ ahụ na-ekwupụta na otu ụlọ akwụkwọ akwụkwọ mechiri. Otu na-amalite na "We regret to inform you..." ma nke ọzọ na "Heads up: we're closed!"
l-e-h3-b01-09.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ihe ngosi kacha kwesịrị ekwesị maka ikpe ọdịiche ụda?
l-e-h3-b01-09.s.s1.r.b: Ọnụọgụ ahịrị enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ụda.
l-e-h3-b01-09.s.s1.r.c: Enweghị ike ikwenye afọ site n'ederede.
l-e-h3-b01-09.s.s1.r.d: Isiokwu bụ otu, ma ụda dị iche.
l-e-h3-b01-09.s.s1.explain: Ọbụlagodi na isiokwu bụ otu, ikwu regret to inform bụ nke nkwanye ùgwù ma ikwu Heads up bụ nke nkịtị. Ụda na-esite n'okwu na udi ahịrịokwu.
l-e-h3-b01-09.s.s2.model.0: Isiokwu bụ otu, ma okwu dị iche, dị ka regret to inform na Heads up, ya mere nhọrọ okwu na-ekpebi ụda.
l-e-h3-b01-09.s.s2.model.1: Otu akụkọ ahụ na-adị iche dabere n'okwu nkwanye ùgwù ma ọ bụ nkịtị, ya mere ị ga-elele okwu na udi ahịrịokwu.

l-e-h3-b01-10.goal: Họrọ ụkpụrụ (ozi) nke achọrọ n'ezie iji mata jikọta okwu ziri ezi, ma kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-e-h3-b01-10.material: heavy rain dị mma, ma strong rain adịghị mma. Okwu abụọ ahụ nwere ihe ọ pụtara yiri ibe ha, ya mere gịnị mere? Chọta ozi achọrọ iji mata jikọta ziri ezi.
l-e-h3-b01-10.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ozi achọrọ n'ezie iji mara ma jikọta dị mma?
l-e-h3-b01-10.s.s1.o.a: Ma okwu ndị ahụ dị ogologo ma siri ike
l-e-h3-b01-10.s.s1.r.a: Ka okwu si siri ike enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na jikọta.
l-e-h3-b01-10.s.s1.o.b: Ma a na-eji okwu abụọ ahụ n'ezie ọnụ ugboro ugboro
l-e-h3-b01-10.s.s1.o.c: Ma okwu ahụ dị n'asụsụ Korea
l-e-h3-b01-10.s.s1.r.c: Asụsụ Korea enweghị ike ịbụ ntọala maka jikọta okwu Bekee.
l-e-h3-b01-10.s.s1.o.d: Ma ihe okwu abụọ ahụ pụtara n'akwụkwọ ọkọwa okwu bụ otu
l-e-h3-b01-10.s.s1.r.d: Ọbụlagodi na ihe ọ pụtara bụ otu, okwu na-eso ha nke ọma dị iche.
l-e-h3-b01-10.s.s1.explain: A na-ekpebi jikọta site n'ojiji n'ezie karịa ihe ọ pụtara. Lelee ma a na-eji ha ọnụ ugboro ugboro site n'ahịrịokwu ihe atụ nke akwụkwọ ọkọwa okwu ma ọ bụ corpus.
l-e-h3-b01-10.s.s2.model.0: heavy na rain na-eji ọnụ ugboro ugboro n'ezie, ya mere ị nwere ike ịmata ma jikọta dị mma naanị site n'ilele ojiji.
l-e-h3-b01-10.s.s2.model.1: Ọbụlagodi na ihe ha pụtara yiri, a naghị eji strong rain, ya mere ị nweghị ike ịmata site n'ihe ọ pụtara n'akwụkwọ ọkọwa okwu naanị ma ị ga-elele ma a na-eji ha ọnụ.

l-e-h3-b02-06.goal: Chọpụta ozi a chọrọ kpamkpam iji chọta preposition na-abịa mgbe adjective, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ị ji họrọ ya.
l-e-h3-b02-06.material: Ị chọrọ ịhọrọ preposition ziri ezi maka oghere n'"I am interested ___ music." Kpebie ozi a chọrọ n'ezie.
l-e-h3-b02-06.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ozi a chọrọ n'ezie iji họrọ preposition?
l-e-h3-b02-06.s.s1.r.a: Ogologo enweghị ihe ọ gbasara preposition.
l-e-h3-b02-06.s.s1.o.b: Ma aha music na-abịa mgbe ya metụtara ụda
l-e-h3-b02-06.s.s1.r.b: Ihe music pụtara anaghị ekpebi preposition.
l-e-h3-b02-06.s.s1.r.c: Ọnụọgụ ndị mmadụ enweghị ihe ọ gbasara preposition.
l-e-h3-b02-06.s.s1.explain: Preposition mgbe adjective bụ nke e kpebiri maka adjective ọ bụla. Mụta ha dị ka ụzọ abụọ, dịka interested in, good at, na afraid of.
l-e-h3-b02-06.s.s2.model.0: Adjective ọ bụla nwere preposition nke ya, ya mere ị ghaghị ịmara kedu preposition interested na-eso.
l-e-h3-b02-06.s.s2.model.1: Ọbụlagodi na aha na-abịa mgbe ya na-agbanwe, interested in na-anọgide otu, ya mere ụzọ abụọ ya na adjective bụ ozi ị chọrọ.

l-e-h3-b02-07.topic: Ebe a na-etinye ịdọ aka ná ntị
l-e-h3-b02-07.goal: Chọpụta ozi a chọrọ kpamkpam iji chọta ebe a ga-etinye ịdọ aka ná ntị n'akwụkwọ ntụziaka, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ị ji họrọ ya.
l-e-h3-b02-07.material: Ị ga-etinye ịdọ aka ná ntị "Warning: hot surface" n'akwụkwọ ntụziaka ngwa ụlọ. Kpebie ozi a chọrọ n'ezie iji kpebie ebe a ga-etinye ya.
l-e-h3-b02-07.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ozi a chọrọ n'ezie iji kpebie ebe a ga-etinye ịdọ aka ná ntị?
l-e-h3-b02-07.s.s1.o.a: N'nzọụkwụ kedu ka ihe ize ndụ na-apụta
l-e-h3-b02-07.s.s1.o.b: Ugboro ole a ga-ekwughachi ịdọ aka ná ntị
l-e-h3-b02-07.s.s1.o.c: Okwu ole ịdọ aka ná ntị nwere
l-e-h3-b02-07.s.s1.r.c: Ogologo enweghị ihe ọ gbasara ọnọdụ.
l-e-h3-b02-07.s.s1.r.d: Ọnụọgụ peeji abụghị ọkwa maka ọnọdụ.
l-e-h3-b02-07.s.s1.explain: A ghaghị itinye ịdọ aka ná ntị ozugbo tupu nzọụkwụ ebe ihe ize ndụ na-apụta, ka ndị mmadụ gụọ ya ma kpachara anya.
l-e-h3-b02-07.s.s2.model.0: Ị ghaghị ịmara nzọụkwụ ebe ihe ize ndụ na-apụta iji tinye ịdọ aka ná ntị ozugbo tupu ya, ya mere a chọrọ ozi a.
l-e-h3-b02-07.s.s2.model.1: Ịdọ aka ná ntị abaghị uru ma ndị mmadụ eme ihe tupu ha agụọ ya, ya mere ịmara nzọụkwụ nke dị ize ndụ bụ ihe a chọrọ kpamkpam.

l-e-h3-b02-08.goal: Chọpụta ozi a chọrọ kpamkpam iji kpebie ma ihe abụọ a na-atụnyere dabara adaba, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ị ji họrọ ya.
l-e-h3-b02-08.material: Ị chọrọ ịkpebi ma ntụnyere ziri ezi n'ahịrịokwu "The weather in Busan is warmer than Seoul."
l-e-h3-b02-08.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọkwa maka ikpebi ma ntụnyere ziri ezi?
l-e-h3-b02-08.s.s1.r.a: Udi ahụ ziri ezi, mana nsogbu bụ ihe a na-atụnyere.
l-e-h3-b02-08.s.s1.o.b: Ma aha obodo abụọ ahụ nwere otu ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede
l-e-h3-b02-08.s.s1.r.b: Ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede enweghị ihe ọ gbasara ntụnyere.
l-e-h3-b02-08.s.s1.o.c: Ma ihe abụọ a na-atụnyere bụ otu udi
l-e-h3-b02-08.s.s1.o.d: Ugboro ole the na-apụta n'ahịrịokwu ahụ
l-e-h3-b02-08.s.s1.explain: Ahịrịokwu ahụ na-atụnyere ihu igwe na obodo (Seoul), ya mere ọ na-ada ịtụnanya. Tụnyere otu udi ihe, dịka the weather in Busan ... than that in Seoul.
l-e-h3-b02-08.s.s2.model.0: Weather na Seoul bụ ihe dị iche, ya mere ọkwa ahụ bụ ma ị na-atụnyere otu udi ihe.
l-e-h3-b02-08.s.s2.model.1: Ọbụlagodi na udi comparative ziri ezi, ọ na-ada ịtụnanya ma ihe a na-atụnyere dị iche, ya mere ị ghaghị ilele ma ihe abụọ ahụ bụ otu udi.

l-e-h3-b02-09.material: Mbụ: "Most commuters switched to bikes, though some still drive." Nchịkọta nwa akwụkwọ: "All commuters bike now." Ị chọrọ ịkpebi ma nchịkọta ahụ ziri ezi.

l-e-h3-b02-09.s.s1.r.b: Ịdị mkpụmkpụ bụ naanị ihe a na-atụ anya maka nchịkọta.

l-e-h3-b02-09.s.s1.r.c: Ọbụlagodi na ụtọasụsụ ziri ezi, ọdịnaya nwere ike ịbụ ihe na-ezighị ezi.

l-e-h3-b03-07.material: Ntụziaka isi nri: "Add chili if you like." "Stir well." "Serve with rice, if you want." Kpebie nzọụkwụ ndị a na-ekwesịghị ime.
l-e-h3-b03-07.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ihe ngosi na-egosi nzọụkwụ ị nwere ike ịhapụ?
l-e-h3-b03-07.s.s1.r.a: Stir well dị mkpụmkpụ kwa, ma a ga-eme ya.
l-e-h3-b03-07.s.s1.r.b: Ahịrị okwu niile na-akwụsị na ntụpọ.
l-e-h3-b03-07.s.s1.o.c: Ma e nwere okwu ọnọdụ dị ka if you like
l-e-h3-b03-07.s.s1.o.d: Ma ọ na-amalite site na ngwaa
l-e-h3-b03-07.s.s1.r.d: Ha niile na-amalite site na ngwaa, ya mere enweghị ike ịkewa ha.
l-e-h3-b03-07.s.s1.explain: if you like na if you want pụtara ime ya naanị mgbe ịchọrọ. Okwu ndị a bụ ihe ngosi nke nzọụkwụ nhọrọ.
l-e-h3-b03-07.s.s2.model.0: if you like na if you want pụtara ime ya naanị mgbe ịchọrọ, ya mere ha na-egosi nzọụkwụ nhọrọ.

l-e-h3-b03-08.goal: Kpebie ụkpụrụ (ozi) dị mkpa kpamkpam iji chọpụta ụdị okwu na-abịa mgbe neither ... nor, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara i ji họrọ ya.
l-e-h3-b03-08.material: Ị chọrọ ikpebi ụdị (ụdị okwu) nke okwu dabara n'ebe efu n'"The soup is neither hot nor ____." Kpebie ozi achọrọ.
l-e-h3-b03-08.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ozi achọrọ iji kpebie ụdị nke ebe efu?
l-e-h3-b03-08.s.s1.o.a: Ụdị okwu nke okwu ozugbo mgbe neither
l-e-h3-b03-08.s.s1.r.b: Ụtọ anaghị ekpebi ụdị ụtụ asụsụ.
l-e-h3-b03-08.s.s1.o.c: Ma is dị n'oge ugbu a
l-e-h3-b03-08.s.s1.r.c: Oge enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ụdị mgbe nor.
l-e-h3-b03-08.s.s1.r.d: Ogologo enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ụdị.
l-e-h3-b03-08.s.s1.explain: N'neither hot, hot bụ nkọwa, ya mere nkọwa ga-abịarịkwa mgbe nor (neither hot nor cold).
l-e-h3-b03-08.s.s2.model.0: Hot mgbe neither bụ nkọwa, ya mere akụkụ mgbe nor ga-akwekọrịrị ya site na nkọwa; ụdị okwu ahụ bụ ozi achọrọ.
l-e-h3-b03-08.s.s2.model.1: Akụkụ abụọ ahụ ga-abụrịrị parallel, ya mere ị chọrọ ịmata ụdị okwu mgbe neither iji kpebie ụdị mgbe nor.

l-e-h3-b03-09.goal: Kpebie ụkpụrụ (ozi) dị mkpa kpamkpam iji chịkọta nsonaazụ nke mkparịta ụka, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara i ji họrọ ya.
l-e-h3-b03-09.material: Mkparịta ụka: A "Are we meeting Friday?" B "Friday is bad. I have a test." A "Thursday then?" B "Thursday works." Ị chọrọ ịchịkọta mkparịta ụka a n'otu ahịrị okwu.

l-e-h3-b03-09.s.s1.o.b: Ahịrị ole mkparịta ụka ahụ nwere
l-e-h3-b03-09.s.s1.r.c: Usoro ndị kwuru okwu abụghị isi ihe.
l-e-h3-b03-09.s.s1.r.d: A jụrụ aro mbụ, ya mere ọ bụghị ihe e kpebiri.
l-e-h3-b03-09.s.s1.explain: Mkparịta ụka ahụ kwụsịrị site n'ikpebi izute na Tọzdee. Tinye mkpebi a kwetara na nchịkọta.
l-e-h3-b03-09.s.s2.model.0: Isi ihe mkparịta ụka ahụ bụ nzukọ Tọzdee e kpebiri na njedebe, ya mere mkpebi ahụ bụ ụkpụrụ.
l-e-h3-b03-09.s.s2.model.1: A jụrụ aro Fraịdee, ya mere nsonaazụ, Tọzdee, ka a ga-etinye na nchịkọta.

l-e-h3-b03-10.s.s1.prompt: Ozi dị aṅaa dị ezigbo mkpa iji kewaa ihe sorry pụtara?
l-e-h3-b03-10.s.s1.o.a: Ma sorry nọ na mmalite ahịrịokwu kpọmkwem
l-e-h3-b03-10.s.s1.r.a: Ọ dị na mmalite ahịrịokwu abụọ ahụ.
l-e-h3-b03-10.s.s1.o.b: Ma onye na-ekwu okwu kpatara ihe ahụ
l-e-h3-b03-10.s.s1.r.c: Ọnụọgụ okwu anaghị ekewa ihe ha pụtara.
l-e-h3-b03-10.s.s1.o.d: Ma ọ malitere na mkpụrụedemede ukwu
l-e-h3-b03-10.s.s1.r.d: Ahịrịokwu abụọ ahụ malitere na mkpụrụedemede ukwu.

l-e-h3-b03-10.s.s2.model.0: Ịbịa n'oge bụ ihe onye na-ekwu okwu kpatara, ya mere ọ bụ mgbaghara; ihe onye nke ọzọ mere bụ ọmịiko, ya mere onye kpatara ya bụ ụkpụrụ.

l-e-h3-b04-06.goal: Họpụta ọkọlọtọ (ozi) nke dị mkpa kpamkpam iji chọpụta ma jiri make ma ọ bụ do tupu noun, ma kọwaa ihe mere ị họọrọ ya.

l-e-h3-b04-06.s.s1.r.c: Nouns ndị na-abụghị ihe, dị ka make a mistake, na-agakwa na make.

l-e-h3-b04-09.goal: Họpụta ọkwa (ozi) a chọrọ kpamkpam iji chọpụta ihe ga-etinye n'nchịkọta, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ị ji họrọ ya.
l-e-h3-b04-09.material: E nwere ederede dị ogologo na-akọwa otú aṅụ si ebu pollen n'etiti okooko osisi ihe ọkụkụ. N'etiti e nwere akụkọ ogologo gbasara nkita onye ọrụ ugbo. Kpebie ihe ga-etinye n'nchịkọta.
l-e-h3-b04-09.s.s1.prompt: Gịnị ka ị ghaghị ịtụle iji kpebie ma ị ga-etinye ya?

l-e-h3-b04-09.s.s1.r.b: Ogologo ahịrịokwu anaghị agwa gị ka ihe dị mkpa.
l-e-h3-b04-09.s.s1.o.c: Ma ọ metụtara isi echiche nke ederede
l-e-h3-b04-09.s.s1.o.d: Ma ọ bụ akụkọ na-atọ ụtọ ịgụ
l-e-h3-b04-09.s.s1.r.d: Ịtọ ụtọ na ịdị mkpa bụ ihe dị iche.

l-e-h3-b05-06.material: Slim, skinny, na thin niile pụtara thin. Ịchọrọ ịmata nke n'ime okwu ahụ dị nso na otuto mgbe ị na-akọwa mmadụ.

l-e-h3-b05-06.s.s1.r.b: Ogologo nke ọkpụkpụ anaghị agwa gị ma ọ bụ otuto ma ọ bụ ọ bụghị.
l-e-h3-b05-06.s.s1.o.c: Ma okwu ahụ na-abịa n'oge na usoro akwụkwọ ọkọwa okwu
l-e-h3-b05-06.s.s1.r.c: Usoro akwụkwọ ọkọwa okwu enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na mmetụta nke okwu.
l-e-h3-b05-06.s.s1.r.d: Ọnụọgụ syllables enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na mmetụta nke okwu.
l-e-h3-b05-06.s.s1.explain: Ọbụlagodi na ihe ha pụtara bụ otu, okwu ọ bụla na-enye mmetụta dị iche. Slim nwere mmetụta ọma ma skinny nwere mmetụta nke ịdị gbasie nke ukwuu.
l-e-h3-b05-06.s.s2.model.0: Ọbụlagodi na ihe ha pụtara bụ otu, okwu ọ bụla nwere mmetụta ọma ma ọ bụ ọjọọ dị iche, ya mere ịchọrọ ịmara mmetụta ahụ.
l-e-h3-b05-06.s.s2.model.1: Slim na skinny nwere otu ihe ọ pụtara ma mmetụta dị iche, ya mere mmetụta okwu na-enye bụ ụkpụrụ.

l-e-h3-b04-11.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke adverbs na-aga tupu okwu mmetụta, wee lelee iwu ahụ site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-h3-b04-11.material: Highly recommended, highly unlikely, highly skilled / deeply grateful, deeply worried, deeply sorry. Chọta iwu ma mejupụta oghere: Mina felt ____ ashamed.
l-e-h3-b04-11.s.s1.r.a: N'ihe atụ ndị ahụ, highly na-eso okwu nke nyocha ma ọ bụ ohere. Na mmetụta, ọ bụ deeply.
l-e-h3-b04-11.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụghị ụzọ abụọ n'ihe atụ ndị ahụ, ọ bụkwaghị mmekọ e kpebiri na ashamed.
l-e-h3-b04-11.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụghị ụzọ abụọ n'ihe atụ ndị ahụ, ọ bụkwaghị mmekọ e kpebiri na ashamed.
l-e-h3-b04-11.s.s1.explain: N'ihe atụ ndị ahụ, a na-eji deeply tupu mmetụta (grateful, worried, sorry). Ashamed bụkwa mmetụta, ya mere ọ bụ deeply ashamed.
l-e-h3-b04-11.s.s2.model.0: A na-eji Deeply na mmetụta dịka grateful, worried, na sorry, ya mere deeply dabara na ashamed kwa.
l-e-h3-b04-11.s.s2.model.1: Iwu bụ iji deeply tupu okwu na-egosi mmetụta, ya mere ọ bụ deeply ashamed.

l-e-h3-b07-02.title: Gịnị ka absolutely na-aga na ya?
l-e-h3-b07-02.goal: Site n'ọtụtụ ikpe nke adjectives absolutely na very na-eji, kwuo iwu ahụ, wee lelee iwu ahụ site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-h3-b07-02.material: Dị okike: very tired, very interesting, absolutely huge, absolutely exhausted. Ihe ịtụnanya: absolutely tired, absolutely interesting, very huge, very exhausted.
l-e-h3-b07-02.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ iwu na-akọwa ikpe niile dị n'elu.
l-e-h3-b07-02.s.s1.o.a: A na-eji Absolutely naanị tupu adjectives ogologo
l-e-h3-b07-02.s.s1.r.a: Ọbụna na interesting dị ogologo, ọ na-ada ka ihe ịtụnanya na absolutely, ma huge dị okike ọbụna na ọ dị mkpụmkpụ.
l-e-h3-b07-02.s.s1.o.b: Enweghị ike iji Very tupu okwu na-agwụ na -ed
l-e-h3-b07-02.s.s1.r.b: Very tired dị okike ọbụna na ọ na-agwụ na -ed.
l-e-h3-b07-02.s.s1.o.c: A na-eji Absolutely naanị na ihe pụtara adịghị mma
l-e-h3-b07-02.s.s1.r.c: Tired nwere ihe pụtara adịghị mma, mana ọ na-ada ka ihe ịtụnanya na absolutely.

l-e-h3-b07-02.s.s1.explain: Huge na exhausted nwere ihe pụtara dị oke ugbu a, ya mere ha na-ejikọta na absolutely. Tired na interesting na-aga na very, nke na-agbanwe ogo.
l-e-h3-b07-02.s.s2.model.0: Iwu bụ na huge na exhausted nwere ihe pụtara dị oke ugbu a, ya mere a na-eji ha na absolutely, ebe tired na interesting na-eji very.

l-e-h3-b01-20.title: Kedu akara ọkwa ihe omume ahịrị okwu a nwetara?
l-e-h3-b01-20.goal: Tụọ anya ọkwa ihe omume ahịrị okwu nwere, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ ókè kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-h3-b01-20.material: Tụọ ọkwa ihe omume site na 1 (nkịtị nke ukwuu) ruo 5 (ihe omume nke ukwuu). Ahịrị okwu: "Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to enquire about your opening hours."
l-e-h3-b01-20.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọkwa ihe omume a tụrụ anya nke ahịrị okwu a?
l-e-h3-b01-20.s.s1.r.a: Dear Sir or Madam bụ ekele ihe omume nke ukwuu.
l-e-h3-b01-20.s.s1.r.b: I am writing to enquire abụghị ụzọ nkịtị isi kwuo okwu.
l-e-h3-b01-20.s.s1.r.c: Iji kpọọ ya n'etiti, e nwere ọtụtụ okwu ihe omume.
l-e-h3-b01-20.s.s1.explain: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to enquire bụ okwu siri ike, nke ihe omume nke a na-eji n'akwụkwọ ozi. Ọ dị nso na 5.
l-e-h3-b01-20.s.s2.model.0: Dear Sir or Madam na I am writing to enquire bụ okwu ihe omume, ya mere ọ dị nso na 5.
l-e-h3-b01-20.s.s2.model.1: Ndị a bụ ekele na ụdị ahịrị okwu siri ike ị gaghị eji na enyi, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka 5.

l-e-h3-b02-16.title: Ahịrịokwu isi ole ga-afọdụ?
l-e-h3-b02-16.goal: Mee atụmatụ ahịrịokwu ole ga-afọdụ na nchịkọta, họrọ oke dabara adaba ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-h3-b02-16.material: Ederede nwere ahịrịokwu 8. N’ime ha, 3 bụ ihe atụ, 2 na-emegharị ihe bu ụzọ. Mee atụmatụ ahịrịokwu ole nwere isi ọhụrụ.
l-e-h3-b02-16.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụọgụ ahịrịokwu kacha dabara ka e debe na nchịkọta?
l-e-h3-b02-16.s.s1.r.a: Isi ihe nwere ike ịdị abụọ ma ọ bụ karịa. Ahịrịokwu 3 ga-afọdụ.
l-e-h3-b02-16.s.s1.r.c: Ọnụọgụ ahụ gụnyere ihe atụ na mmegharị.
l-e-h3-b02-16.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ bụ ederede mbụ dum, ya mere ọ bụghị nchịkọta.
l-e-h3-b02-16.s.s1.explain: 8-3-2=3; ya mere e nwere ihe dị ka ahịrịokwu isi ọhụrụ 3. Wepụ ihe atụ na mmegharị.
l-e-h3-b02-16.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na i wepụ ihe atụ 3 na mmegharị 2 n’ime 8, 3 ga-afọdụ; ya mere debe ihe dị ka 3.
l-e-h3-b02-16.s.s2.model.1: Ihe atụ na mmegharị bụ 5; ya mere 8-5=3, ihe dị ka ahịrịokwu isi 3.

l-e-h3-b02-17.title: Oge ole ka akwụkwọ ntuziaka dum ga-ewe?
l-e-h3-b02-17.goal: Mee atụmatụ ngụkọta oge nzọụkwụ dị n’akwụkwọ ntuziaka, họrọ oke dabara adaba ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-h3-b02-17.material: Akwụkwọ ntuziaka: 1. Gwakọta nkeji 5 2. Hapụ ka ọ zuru ike nkeji 30 3. Sie ya nkeji 25 4. Mee ka ọ jụọ nkeji 15. Mee atụmatụ oge iji rụchaa ihe niile.
l-e-h3-b02-17.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ngụkọta oge kacha dabara adaba?
l-e-h3-b02-17.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ bụ oge naanị otu nzọụkwụ.
l-e-h3-b02-17.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ bụ uru nke ile naanị nzọụkwụ kacha ogologo anya.
l-e-h3-b02-17.s.s1.o.d: Ihe dị ka 1 awa na nkeji 15.
l-e-h3-b02-17.s.s1.explain: 5+30+25+15=75 nkeji; ya mere ihe dị ka 1 awa na nkeji 15. A ga-agbakọta nzọụkwụ niile ọnụ.
l-e-h3-b02-17.s.s2.model.0: 5+30+25+15=75 nkeji; ya mere ihe dị ka 1 awa na nkeji 15.
l-e-h3-b02-17.s.s2.model.1: Nzọụkwụ ọ bụla nwere oge nke ya; ngụkọta bụ ha niile ọnụ, nkeji 75, ya bụ ihe dị ka 1 awa na nkeji 15.

l-e-h3-b02-18.title: Ikwu njakịrị ole ga-adị?
l-e-h3-b02-18.goal: Mee atụmatụ okwu njakịrị ole dị na mkparịta ụka, họrọ oke dabara adaba ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-h3-b02-18.material: N’ime ahịrị 20 nke mkparịta ụka, okwu njakịrị na-apụta otu ugboro n’ahịrị 4. Mee atụmatụ ugboro ole ọ ga-apụta.
l-e-h3-b02-18.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụọgụ okwu njakịrị kacha dabara adaba?
l-e-h3-b02-18.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ bụ ugboro ole ga-adị ma ọ bụrụ otu n’ahịrị 10.
l-e-h3-b02-18.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ bụ ugboro ole ma ọ bụrụ otu n’ahịrị 2.
l-e-h3-b02-18.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ bụ ugboro ole ma ọ bụrụ na ọ pụta n’ahịrị ọ bụla.
l-e-h3-b02-18.s.s1.explain: 20 kewara na 4 bụ 5. Okwu njakịrị ga-apụta ihe dị ka ugboro 5.
l-e-h3-b02-18.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na e kewaa ahịrị 20 na 4, 20÷4=5; ya mere ihe dị ka ugboro 5.
l-e-h3-b02-18.s.s2.model.1: Ọ na-eme otu ugboro n’ahịrị 4; ya mere n’ahịrị 20 a pụrụ ime atụmatụ ugboro 5.

l-e-h3-b03-16.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ sonyere nke kacha dabara adaba?
l-e-h3-b03-16.title: Mmadụ ole bụ ihe dị ka ụzọ abụọ n'ụzọ atọ?
l-e-h3-b03-16.goal: Tụọ ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị mmadụ ihe dị ka ụzọ abụọ n'ụzọ atọ na-anọchi anya, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke dabara, kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-h3-b03-16.material: Akụkọ kwuru: ‘Ihe dị ka ụzọ abụọ n'ụzọ atọ n'ime ụmụ akwụkwọ 90 sonyere.’ Tụọ ụmụ akwụkwọ ole sonyere.
l-e-h3-b03-16.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ ọnụọgụ kwekọrọ na 1/3.
l-e-h3-b03-16.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ ọnụọgụ kwekọrọ na ọkara.
l-e-h3-b03-16.s.s1.explain: 2/3 nke 90 bụ 60. Ihe dị ka pụtara ihe na-eru nso 60, ya mere ihe dị ka ụmụ akwụkwọ 60.
l-e-h3-b03-16.s.s2.model.0: 90÷3=30, 30×2=60, ya mere ihe dị ka ụmụ akwụkwọ 60.
l-e-h3-b03-16.s.s2.model.1: Ịgbakọ 2/3 nke 90 na-enye 60, ya mere ihe dị ka ụmụ akwụkwọ 60 ziri ezi.

l-e-h3-b03-17.title: Kedu oge ị ga-abịa dịka ọkwa ọkwa si kwuo?
l-e-h3-b03-17.goal: Tụọ ngụkọta oge dị n'ọkwa ọkwa, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke dabara, kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-h3-b03-17.material: Ọkwa ọkwa: ‘Nzukọ ga-amalite n'elekere 9:40. Biko bịarute nkeji 25 tupu.’ Tụọ oge ị ga-abịarute.
l-e-h3-b03-17.s.s1.prompt: Kedu oge kacha dabara iji bịarute?
l-e-h3-b03-17.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ oge ịbịa nkeji 35 tupu.
l-e-h3-b03-17.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ oge ịbịa nkeji 15 tupu.
l-e-h3-b03-17.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ oge mgbe mmalite gasịrị.
l-e-h3-b03-17.s.s1.explain: 9:40 wepụ nkeji 25 bụ 9:15. Early pụtara tupu mmalite, ya mere oge ahụ ga-abụ tupu mmalite.
l-e-h3-b03-17.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụ nkeji 25 tupu 9:40, ya mere ị ga-abịarute ka ọ na-erule 9:15.
l-e-h3-b03-17.s.s2.model.1: Early pụtara tupu mmalite, ya mere 9:40 wepụ nkeji 25 na-enye 9:15.

l-e-h3-b03-18.title: N'ime ederede okwu 200, ndepụta yiri ibe ha ole dị?
l-e-h3-b03-18.goal: Tụọ ndepụta yiri ibe ha dị n'ederede, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke dabara, kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-h3-b03-18.material: N'edemede okwu 200, ndepụta yiri ibe ya na-apụta ihe dị ka otu ugboro n'okwu 50. Tụọ ugboro ole ndepụta na-apụta.
l-e-h3-b03-18.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụ ọgụgụ kacha dabara maka ugboro ndepụta pụtara?
l-e-h3-b03-18.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụrụ na ọ na-apụta okwu 50 ọ bụla, ọ ga-abụ ihe karịrị otu ugboro.
l-e-h3-b03-18.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ ugboro ole ọ ga-apụta ma ọ bụrụ na ọ pụta okwu 20 ọ bụla.
l-e-h3-b03-18.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ ugboro ole ọ ga-apụta ma ọ bụrụ na ọ pụta okwu 5 ọ bụla.
l-e-h3-b03-18.s.s1.explain: 200÷50=4, ya mere ndepụta na-apụta ihe dị ka ugboro 4.
l-e-h3-b03-18.s.s2.model.0: Ikewa okwu 200 n'ìgwè okwu 50 na-enye 200÷50=4, ya mere ihe dị ka ugboro 4.
l-e-h3-b03-18.s.s2.model.1: Ìgwè okwu 50 anọ (4) na-eme okwu 200, ya mere ndepụta yiri ibe ya na-apụtakwa ihe dị ka ugboro 4.

l-e-h3-b03-19.title: Nchịkọta ahụ bụ pasent ole nke nke mbụ?
l-e-h3-b03-19.goal: Tụọ oke nchịkọta ahụ nwere n'ime nke mbụ, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke dabara, kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-h3-b03-19.material: Nke mbụ nwere okwu 500, nchịkọta ahụ nwere okwu 50. Tụọ oke nchịkọta ahụ nwere n'ime ederede mbụ.
l-e-h3-b03-19.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ oke ma ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ ihe dị ka okwu 5.
l-e-h3-b03-19.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ oke ma ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ ihe dị ka okwu 250.
l-e-h3-b03-19.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ oke ma ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ ihe dị ka okwu 450.
l-e-h3-b03-19.s.s1.explain: 50÷500=0.1, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka 10%.
l-e-h3-b03-19.s.s2.model.0: Ikewa 50 na 500 na-enye 0.1, ya mere ihe dị ka 10%.
l-e-h3-b03-19.s.s2.model.1: Okwu 50 bụ 1/10 nke okwu 500, ya mere tụọ ya ka ọ bụrụ ihe dị ka 10%.

l-e-h3-b03-20.title: Ọ bụrụ na i jiri ihe nlele nyocha tụọ ihe niile, gịnị ka ị ga-enweta?
l-e-h3-b03-20.goal: Mee atụmatụ ọnụọgụ nyocha na-eto eto n’ìgwè nyocha niile site n’ụda olu nke ihe atụ; họrọ oke dabara adaba ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-h3-b03-20.material: N’ime nyocha 200, a họpụtara 20 gụọ, 15 n’ime ha nwere ụda otuto. Mee atụmatụ nyocha ole n’ime 200 ga-eto eto.
l-e-h3-b03-20.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụọgụ nyocha otuto kacha dabara adaba?
l-e-h3-b03-20.s.s1.r.a: O were ọnụọgụ dị n’ihe atụ dịka ngụkọta niile.
l-e-h3-b03-20.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ uru nke na-ewere ihe fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ ha niile dịka otuto.
l-e-h3-b03-20.s.s1.explain: 15÷20=0.75, 200×0.75=150. Jiri ogo ihe atụ mee atụmatụ maka ngụkọta.
l-e-h3-b03-20.s.s2.model.0: N’ihe atụ, 15 n’ime 20 bụ 75%, 75% nke 200 bụ ihe dị ka 150.
l-e-h3-b03-20.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na ihe atụ ahụ nọchiri anya ha niile, mụbaa 200 na pasent 75%; ihe dị ka 150 ziri ezi.

l-e-h3-b04-16.title: Ogologo nchịkọta maka ederede okwu 400
l-e-h3-b04-16.goal: Tụọ atụmatụ ọnụọgụ okwu dị n'nchịkọta e mebiri ka ọ bụrụ 1/4 nke mbụ, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-h3-b04-16.material: Ị chọrọ ịchịkọta ederede okwu 400 ruo ihe dị ka 1/4 nke ogologo mbụ. Tụọ atụmatụ ọnụọgụ okwu dị n'nchịkọta.
l-e-h3-b04-16.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụọgụ okwu kwesịrị ekwesị maka nchịkọta?
l-e-h3-b04-16.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ uru a gbakọrọ dị ka ọkara nke mbụ.
l-e-h3-b04-16.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ uru a gbakọrọ dị ka 3/4 nke mbụ.
l-e-h3-b04-16.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ uru a gbakọrọ dị ka 1/10 nke mbụ.
l-e-h3-b04-16.s.s1.explain: 1/4 nke 400 bụ 100. Ya mere ihe dị ka okwu 100 kwesịrị ekwesị.
l-e-h3-b04-16.s.s2.model.0: 1/4 nke okwu 400 bụ 100, ya mere nchịkọta bụ ihe dị ka okwu 100.
l-e-h3-b04-16.s.s2.model.1: 400 kewara site na 4 bụ 100, ya mere ihe dị ka okwu 100 kwesịrị ekwesị.

l-e-h3-b06-19.title: Itụnyere ogologo nke edemede na isiokwu ya
l-e-h3-b06-19.goal: Tụ anya ka e si mee ka edemede dị mkpụmkpụ ruo isiokwu iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-h3-b06-19.material: Edemede dị okwu 240. Ị na-eme ya ka ọ dị mkpụmkpụ ruo isiokwu nke ihe dị ka okwu 8. Tụ anya ihe dị ka pasent ole nke ihe mbụ ogologo isiokwu bụ.
l-e-h3-b06-19.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ 30%, ọ ga-abụ ihe dị ka okwu 72.
l-e-h3-b06-19.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ 50%, ọ ga-abụ okwu 120.
l-e-h3-b06-19.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ 10%, ọ ga-abụ okwu 24.
l-e-h3-b06-19.s.s1.explain: 10% nke 240 bụ 24, ma 8 pere mpe karịa nke ahụ nke ukwuu. 8 ÷ 240 bụ ihe dị ka 0.03, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka 3%.
l-e-h3-b06-19.s.s2.model.0: 8 bụ 1/30 nke 240, nke bụ ihe dị ka 3%, ya mere isiokwu bụ ihe dị ka 3% nke ihe mbụ.
l-e-h3-b06-19.s.s2.model.1: Ịkewa 240 site na 8 na-enye 30, ya mere ọ bụ 1/30 nke ihe mbụ, ya bụ, ihe dị ka 3%.

l-e-h3-b02-21.material: Data: heavy traffic ugboro 5000, strong traffic ugboro 3 (ha niile sitere n’ederede ndị na-amụ asụsụ). Nwa akwụkwọ: ① Heavy traffic ka a na-ahụkarị. ② Strong traffic pụtara ugboro 3 kwa; ya mere ọ ziri ezi. ③ Ha abụọ dị mma.
l-e-h3-b02-21.s.s1.r.a: Ị gụrụ ọnụọgụ ahụ nke ọma.
l-e-h3-b02-21.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ nkwubi okwu sitere na ②; ya mere ọ bụghị njehie mbụ.
l-e-h3-b02-21.s.s1.explain: Ugboro 3 ahụ bụ njehie n’ederede ndị na-amụ asụsụ. Ịpụta ugboro ole na ole anaghị eme ka okwu ahụ bụrụ ojiji ziri ezi.
l-e-h3-b02-21.s.s2.model.0: ② ezighị ezi n’ihi na o gụrụ njehie ndị na-amụ asụsụ dịka ihe atụ ojiji ziri ezi. 5000 na 3 dị nnọọ iche.
l-e-h3-b02-21.s.s2.model.1: Strong traffic pụtara naanị n’ederede ndị na-amụ asụsụ, a naghị ejikarị ya; ya mere ebe mbụ o si hie ụzọ bụ ②.

l-e-h3-b02-22.goal: Soro echiche onye dere akwụkwọ ntuziaka, chọta ebe mbụ o si hie ụzọ ma dozie ya.
l-e-h3-b02-22.material: Akwụkwọ ntuziaka: 1. Wepụ tebụl n’igbe. 2. Tinye ụkwụ ya. 3. Tụgharịa tebụl. Onye dere ya: ① A na-etinye ụkwụ n’okpuru elu tebụl. ② Mgbe e wepụrụ ya n’igbe, elu tebụl chere ihu n’elu. ③ Ya mere a pụrụ itinye ụkwụ ozugbo e wepụtachara ya.
l-e-h3-b02-22.s.s1.r.a: Ikwunye ụkwụ n’okpuru ya ziri ezi.
l-e-h3-b02-22.s.s1.r.b: A pụrụ iwere na elu tebụl chere ihu n’elu dịka eziokwu.
l-e-h3-b02-22.s.s1.r.d: Ị gaghị atụnye ụkwụ n’okpuru elu tebụl nke chere ihu n’elu.
l-e-h3-b02-22.s.s1.explain: Ị gaghị erute n’okpuru elu tebụl ahụ mgbe ọ chere ihu n’elu. Iji tinye ụkwụ, a ga-ebu ụzọ tụgharịa ya.
l-e-h3-b02-22.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe ejikọtara ① na ②, a ga-ebu ụzọ tụgharịa ya; ma ③ kwuru ka e tinye ụkwụ ozugbo, ya mere o ezighị ezi.
l-e-h3-b02-22.s.s2.model.1: Elu tebụl chere ihu n’elu; iji ruo n’okpuru, a ga-ebu ụzọ tụgharịa ya. Ọ bụ ya mere ③ ji ezighị ezi.

l-e-h3-b02-23.goal: Soro echiche nwa akwụkwọ n’idozi ahịrịokwu ntụnyere, chọta ebe mbụ o si hie ụzọ ma dozie ya.
l-e-h3-b02-23.material: Nwa akwụkwọ na-achọ idozi “The prices here are lower than the other shop.”: ① Ihe a na-atụnyere bụ ọnụ ahịa ebe a na ụlọ ahịa nke ọzọ. ② Ọnụ ahịa na ụlọ ahịa bụ ụdị ihe dị iche. ③ Ya mere ọ dị mma ịhapụ ihe na-eso the other shop otu ahụ.
l-e-h3-b02-23.s.s1.r.a: Ị chọpụtara ihe ndị a na-atụnyere nke ọma.
l-e-h3-b02-23.s.s1.r.b: Ịkọwa na ha bụ ụdị dị iche bụkwa eziokwu.
l-e-h3-b02-23.s.s1.explain: ② kwuru na ha bụ ụdị dị iche; ya mere a ga-edozi ya. Tulee ọnụ ahịa na ọnụ ahịa, dịka those at the other shop ma ọ bụ the other shop’s.
l-e-h3-b02-23.s.s2.model.0: ③ ezighị ezi n’ihi na ② kwuru na ha dị iche, ma ③ kwuru ka ahapụ ya otu ahụ; nke ahụ na-emegiderịta onwe ya.
l-e-h3-b02-23.s.s2.model.1: A ga-edozi ya ka those at the other shop ka e jiri ọnụ ahịa tụnyere ọnụ ahịa; ya mere ③ bụ nzọụkwụ na-ezighị ezi.

l-e-h3-b02-24.material: Ederede: “Ahịa si na 100 na 2020 ruo 150 na 2022.” Nwa akwụkwọ: ① Mmụba bụ 50. ② Ọ rịgoro 50 site na 100, ya mere ọ rịgoro 50%. ③ Nchịkọta: Ahịa mụbara okpukpu abụọ.
l-e-h3-b02-24.s.s1.r.d: Okpukpu abụọ ga-abụ 200; ya mere ③ ezighị ezi.
l-e-h3-b02-24.s.s1.explain: Mmụba 50% bụ ugboro 1.5. Okpukpu abụọ ga-abụ 200. Nchịkọta kwesịrị ịbụ “Ahịa mụbara ọkara.”

l-e-h3-b02-25.material: Ederede: “Onye isi obodo ‘ji obiọma’ chetaara onye ọ bụla, nke ugboro ise, na ogige ahụ ka ga-emechi.” Nwa akwụkwọ: ① Kindly bụ okwu otuto. ② A pụrụ ileghara akara nhota na for the fifth time anya. ③ Ya mere onye dere ya nwere echiche ọma banyere onye isi obodo.
l-e-h3-b02-25.s.s1.r.a: Ị nyere ihe kindly pụtara n’akwụkwọ ọkọwa okwu nke ọma.

l-e-h3-b02-25.s.s1.r.d: Nkwubi okwu dị iche na àgwà onye edere ya.

l-e-h3-b02-25.s.s2.model.1: For the fifth time na-egosi iwe, ya mere ekwesịghị ileghara ya anya, ma ② bụ ebe mbụ ọ gbagwojuru.

l-e-h3-b03-21.goal: Soro echiche nke ịhọrọ affect ma ọ bụ effect; chọta ebe mbụ o si hie ụzọ ma dozie ya.
l-e-h3-b03-21.material: “The rain had a big ___ on the crops.” Nwa akwụkwọ: ① E nwere big tupu oghere. ② Noun na-eso big. ③ Ya mere tinye ngwaa affect.
l-e-h3-b03-21.s.s1.r.a: Ọ gụrụ okwu dị n’ihu oghere nke ọma.
l-e-h3-b03-21.s.s1.r.b: O ziri ezi na noun na-eso big.
l-e-h3-b03-21.s.s1.explain: ② kwuru na noun ga-abịa; ya mere jiri noun effect. affect bụ ngwaa pụtara imetụta.
l-e-h3-b03-21.s.s2.model.0: ② kwuru na noun ga-abịa, ma ③ họọrọ ngwaa affect; ya mere o ezighị ezi. Noun effect ziri ezi.

l-e-h3-b03-22.title: Ebee ka o si hie ụzọ mgbe ọ na-eso ntụziaka?
l-e-h3-b03-22.goal: Soro echiche nwa akwụkwọ n’ịgụ ntụziaka, chọta ebe mbụ o si hie ụzọ ma dozie ya.
l-e-h3-b03-22.material: Ntụziaka: “Gaa n’ebe ugwu ngọngọ abụọ. Tụgharịa aka ekpe. Gaa ngọngọ otu. Ọbá akwụkwọ dị n’aka nri gị.” Nwa akwụkwọ: ① Gaa ugwu ngọngọ abụọ. ② Ịtụgharị aka ekpe, ihu gị ga-aga n’ebe ọwụwa anyanwụ. ③ Mgbe ngọngọ gachara, ọbá akwụkwọ dị n’aka nri, ya bụ ndịda.
l-e-h3-b03-22.s.s1.r.a: Ọ ziri ezi na ị ga-aga ugwu.
l-e-h3-b03-22.s.s1.r.d: Ntụziaka ahụ ezighị ezi na ②.
l-e-h3-b03-22.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na ihu gị dị n’ebe ugwu wee tụgharịa aka ekpe, ihu gị ga-aga ọdịda anyanwụ. N’ebe ọdịda anyanwụ, aka nri gị bụ ugwu; ya mere ọbá akwụkwọ dị n’ugwu.
l-e-h3-b03-22.s.s2.model.0: Na ②, ịtụgharị aka ekpe mgbe ihu dị n’ugwu na-atụgharị ihu gaa ọdịda anyanwụ, ma ọ sịrị ọwụwa anyanwụ; ya mere ọ bụ njehie.
l-e-h3-b03-22.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na i gawa ọdịda anyanwụ, ọbá akwụkwọ dị n’aka nri n’ebe ugwu; ya mere ② bụ njehie mbụ.

l-e-h3-b03-23.goal: Soro usoro echiche n’idozi ahịrịokwu either ... or, chọta njehie mbụ ma dozie ya.
l-e-h3-b03-23.material: Nwa akwụkwọ na-edozi “Either you can call me or send a message.”: ① either ... or na-ejikọta nhọrọ abụọ. ② you can call me bụ ahịrịokwu, send a message bụ verb phrase. ③ Ha abụọ bụ nhọrọ, ya mere usoro ha kwekọrọ.
l-e-h3-b03-23.s.s1.r.a: O kọwara ojiji either ... or nke ọma.
l-e-h3-b03-23.s.s1.r.b: O chọpụtara ụdị akụkụ abụọ ahụ nke ọma.

l-e-h3-b03-23.s.s2.model.0: ② kwuru na ụdị ha dị iche, ③ kwuo na ha parallel; ya mere ọ ezighị ezi.
l-e-h3-b03-23.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na ụdị ha dị iche, dịka ahịrịokwu na verb phrase, ha adịghị parallel; bugharịa either ka call na send kwekọọ.

l-e-h3-b03-24.s.s1.r.b: Ọ ziri ezi ịmata na ọ bụ ntule.

l-e-h3-b01-28.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ n'ozuzu nke ukwuu, ya mere isi okwu na-efu.

l-e-h3-b02-26.title: Dochie put off n'otu okwu
l-e-h3-b02-26.goal: Gbanwee phrasal verb ka ọ bụrụ verb otu okwu, na-ekwu ya n'ụzọ ọzọ (usoro, tebụl, ihe oyiyi, ma ọ bụ okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere ihe ọ pụtara bụ otu.
l-e-h3-b02-26.material: N'"We put off the meeting until Monday.", put off pụtara ibugharị usoro oge n'oge ka e mesịrị. Dochie ya na verb otu okwu pụtara otu ihe.
l-e-h3-b02-26.s.s1.prompt: Kedu verb pụtara otu ihe dị ka put off?
l-e-h3-b02-26.s.s1.r.b: Ọ pụtara iwepụ ihe, ya mere ọ dị iche na ibugharị ya na Monday.
l-e-h3-b02-26.s.s1.r.c: Ọ pụtara imeghe, ya mere ọ bụghị banyere ibugharị.
l-e-h3-b02-26.s.s1.r.d: Ọ pụtara ibugharị ihe n'oge mbụ, ya mere ọ bụ nke megidere.
l-e-h3-b02-26.s.s1.explain: Postpone pụtara ibugharị ihe e mere atụmatụ ya n'oge ka e mesịrị, nke bụ otu ihe dị ka put off.
l-e-h3-b02-26.s.s2.model.0: Put off pụtara postpone, ma postpone nwere otu ihe ọ pụtara, ya mere ị nwere ike ịgbanwe ya ka ọ bụrụ We postponed the meeting.
l-e-h3-b02-26.s.s2.model.1: Cancel pụtara iwepụ ihe, ya mere postpone, nke pụtara ibugharị ya na Monday, bụ nke ziri ezi.

l-e-h3-b02-28.material: "Our goals are to save money, reducing waste, and the planting of trees." nwere ụdị agwakọtara. Dozie ihe na-abịa mgbe 'Our goals are' ka ọ bụrụ nke yiri ibe ya nwere otu ihe ọ pụtara.
l-e-h3-b02-28.s.s1.prompt: Kedu akụkụ e dozịrị ka ọ bụrụ nke yiri ibe ya nwere otu ihe ọ pụtara?
l-e-h3-b02-28.s.s1.r.b: Naanị planting nwere ụdị dị iche.
l-e-h3-b02-28.s.s1.r.c: Ụdị ndị ahụ agwakọtara ma grammar adịghị mma nakwa.
l-e-h3-b02-28.s.s1.r.d: Verb na-apụ, ya mere ihe ọ pụtara na-agbanwe.
l-e-h3-b02-28.s.s1.explain: To save, (to) reduce, na (to) plant niile nwere otu ụdị verb. Ihe ọ pụtara anaghị agbanwe, ma ha na-adị yiri ibe ha.
l-e-h3-b02-28.s.s2.model.0: Save, reduce, na plant niile kwekọrọ n'otu ụdị verb, ya mere ha yiri ibe ha ma na-edebe ebumnuche atọ mbụ dịka ha dị.
l-e-h3-b02-28.s.s2.model.1: Omume atọ ahụ nwere otu ụdị, ya mere ha yiri ibe ha, ma ihe ichekwa ego, ibelata mkpofu, na ịkụ osisi pụtara anaghị agbanwe.

l-e-h3-b02-29.title: Mee ka ihe mbụ dị mkpụmkpụ n'okwu nke gị
l-e-h3-b02-29.goal: Mee ka ogologo ahịrịokwu dị mkpụmkpụ n'okwu nke gị, na-ekwu ya n'ụzọ ọzọ (usoro, tebụl, ihe oyiyi, ma ọ bụ okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere ihe ọ pụtara bụ otu.
l-e-h3-b02-29.material: Ihe mbụ: "The committee, after weeks of debate, finally voted to build a new bridge." Mee ka ọ dị mkpụmkpụ na-agbanwebeghị ihe ọ pụtara.
l-e-h3-b02-29.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ahịrịokwu e mere ka ọ dị mkpụmkpụ nwere otu ihe ọ pụtara?
l-e-h3-b02-29.s.s1.r.a: Mkpebi (iwuli ebe a na-agafe osimiri) na-efu.
l-e-h3-b02-29.s.s1.r.b: Ihe ọ pụtara gbanwere ka ọ bụrụ nke megidere.
l-e-h3-b02-29.s.s1.explain: Isi isi (arụmụka na mkpebi) na arụmụka kwụsịrị ma a kwadoro ebe a na-agafe osimiri niile ka a na-edebe.
l-e-h3-b02-29.s.s2.model.0: Debate ended; the bridge was approved. pụtara na arụmụka kwụsịrị ma a kwadoro ebe a na-agafe osimiri, ya mere ọ bụ otu.
l-e-h3-b02-29.s.s2.model.1: Ọgwụgwụ nke arụmụka ogologo na mkpebi na a kwadoro ebe a na-agafe osimiri ka a na-edebe, ya mere ihe ọ pụtara bụ otu.

l-e-h3-b02-30.title: Gbanwee "old" ka ọ bụrụ mmetụta ọma
l-e-h3-b02-30.goal: Kwupụta n'ụzọ ọma eziokwu na ụlọ ahịa ochie, na-ekwu ya n'ụzọ ọzọ (usoro, tebụl, ihe oyiyi, ma ọ bụ okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere ihe ọ pụtara bụ otu.
l-e-h3-b02-30.material: Ị na-ewepụta ụlọ ahịa dị afọ 100. Debe eziokwu na ọ ochie, ma gbanwee ya ka ọ ghara ịda ihe ọjọọ.
l-e-h3-b02-30.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ahịrịokwu na-enye mmetụta ọma na-agbanwebeghị eziokwu?
l-e-h3-b02-30.s.s1.r.b: E agbakwunyela ihe worn-out na falling apart pụtara.
l-e-h3-b02-30.s.s1.r.d: Ọ nwere mmetụta ọjọọ nke ịdị n'azụ oge.
l-e-h3-b02-30.s.s1.explain: 100 years of history na-ekwu eziokwu na ọ ochie na mmetụta ọma nke akụkọ ihe mere eme.
l-e-h3-b02-30.s.s2.model.0: 100 years of history na-edebe otu eziokwu nke afọ 100 ma na-enye mmetụta ọma nke inwe akụkọ ihe mere eme, ya mere ọ kwesịrị ekwesị.
l-e-h3-b02-30.s.s2.model.1: Outdated na-eme ka mmadụ chee na ọ dị n'azụ oge, ya mere history, nke nwere otu eziokwu ma nwee mmetụta ọma, dabara n'mgbasa ozi.

l-e-h3-b03-26.goal: Gbanwee expression nwere noun phrase ka ọ bụrụ ngwaa, kọwaa ihe mere ihe ọ pụtara ji bụrụ otu.

l-e-h3-b03-26.s.s1.explain: conclude pụtara iru nkwubi okwu, ya na come to a conclusion bụ otu. Gbanwee ya ka we concluded.

l-e-h3-b03-26.s.s2.model.1: Ngwaa kwekọrọ na conclusion bụ conclude; ya mere ihe ọ pụtara bụ otu.

l-e-h3-b01-31.material: Ederede: "Some towns now put free bike-repair stands on busy paths. Riders say the stands keep them cycling longer." Nchịkọta A: "Free repair stands help riders keep cycling." Nchịkọta B: "Towns have paths, stands, and riders."
l-e-h3-b01-31.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nchịkọta ka mma, ma gịnị mere?

l-e-h3-b01-31.s.s1.o.c: B, n'ihi na ọ na-eji okwu nke ederede dị ka ha dị
l-e-h3-b01-31.s.s1.r.c: Idepụta naanị ihe anaghị egosi isi ihe.
l-e-h3-b01-31.s.s1.r.d: B enweghị isi ihe na ihe ndị guzoro na-enyere ndị na-anya igwe ịnya ya n'ihu aka.

l-e-h3-b01-31.s.s2.model.0: A nwere ma isi ihe ma mmetụta, ya mere ọ bụ nchịkọta ka mma. B bụ ndepụta, ya mere a pụghị ịhụ isi ihe.
l-e-h3-b01-31.s.s2.model.1: B na-edozi okwu naanị, ya mere A kwesịrị ekwesị karịa dị ka nchịkọta.

l-e-h3-b01-32.s.s1.o.c: A, n'ihi na ọ na-ahapụ usoro n'aka onye na-agụ n'ikpeazụ

l-e-h3-b01-33.material: Ụmụ akwụkwọ abụọ dere ahịrịokwu banyere ịchị ụlọ ahịa. A: "I run a small shop." B: "I drive a small shop."

l-e-h3-b01-33.s.s1.o.b: B, n'ihi na drive bụ okwu nwere ike karịa
l-e-h3-b01-33.s.s1.r.b: Okwu nwere ike abụghị nke dị okike mgbe niile.
l-e-h3-b01-33.s.s1.o.c: B, n'ihi na ọ nwere mmetụta nke ịkwaga
l-e-h3-b01-33.s.s1.r.c: Ọ dị anya n'ihe ịchị pụtara.
l-e-h3-b01-33.s.s1.r.d: Verb nke na-adaba na shop bụ run.
l-e-h3-b01-33.s.s1.explain: run a shop bụ pair a na-ejikarị pụtara ịkwado ụlọ ahịa. drive bụ verb a na-eji mgbe a na-anya ụgbọ ala.

l-e-h3-b02-32.s.s1.r.b: Ọ dị ogologo nke ukwuu iji gụọ site n'ebe dị anya.
l-e-h3-b02-32.s.s1.o.c: B, n'ihi na ọ na-ekwu okwu n'ụzọ nkwanye ùgwù
l-e-h3-b02-32.s.s1.r.c: Ịghọta ngwa ngwa dị mkpa karịa ịdị nkwanye ùgwù.
l-e-h3-b02-32.s.s1.r.d: Oge ọ na-ewe ịgụ ya dị iche nke ukwuu.

l-e-h3-b03-32.material: Ntụziaka A: “Gaa ntakịrị n’ụzọ ahụ tụgharịa nso ụlọ ahịa.” B: “Gaa n’ihu ngọngọ abụọ, tụgharịa aka ekpe n’ụlọ akụ.”
l-e-h3-b03-32.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ntụziaka dị mfe iso, gịnịkwa mere?
l-e-h3-b03-32.s.s1.o.a: A, n’ihi na ọ dị mkpirikpi ma dị mfe icheta.
l-e-h3-b03-32.s.s1.r.a: Ọ dị mkpirikpi, ma a maghị ebe a ga-aga.
l-e-h3-b03-32.s.s1.o.b: B, n’ihi na anya, ntụziaka na akara ebe doro anya.
l-e-h3-b03-32.s.s1.r.c: Ụda okwu enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ido anya.
l-e-h3-b03-32.s.s1.explain: B kwuru ngọngọ abụọ, aka ekpe, na ụlọ akụ kpọmkwem. A jiri ntakịrị, ụzọ ahụ, na nso kọwaa n’ụzọ edoghị anya.
l-e-h3-b03-32.s.s2.model.0: B dị mfe iso n’ihi na anya, ntụziaka na akara ebe ya doro anya.
l-e-h3-b03-32.s.s2.model.1: A edoghị anya dịka ntakịrị na nso; ya mere B doro anya karịa.

l-e-h3-b03-33.title: Kedu ndepụta isiokwu dabara adaba karịa?
l-e-h3-b03-33.goal: Tụlee isiokwu abụọ maka ihe ngosi, họrọ nke ka mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-h3-b03-33.material: Ndepụta A: “Nsogbu, Ngwọta, na Nsonaazụ.” Ndepụta B: “Ihe Mere Hie Ụzọ, Idozi Ya, na Nsonaazụ.”
l-e-h3-b03-33.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ndepụta ka dabara adaba, gịnịkwa mere?
l-e-h3-b03-33.s.s1.o.a: B, n’ihi na ọ dị ogologo ma kọwaa nke ọma.
l-e-h3-b03-33.s.s1.o.b: A, n’ihi na isiokwu atọ niile bụ nouns.
l-e-h3-b03-33.s.s1.o.c: B, n’ihi na ọ gwakọtara ụdị ajụjụ.
l-e-h3-b03-33.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ bụ ihe mere udi agwakọtara ji na-ada ka ihe ịtụnanya.
l-e-h3-b03-33.s.s1.r.d: Naanị A nwere otu udi niile.
l-e-h3-b03-33.s.s1.explain: A na-eji nouns maka Problems, Solutions, na Results niile. B na-agwakọta clause, -ing, na noun, ya mere ọ bụghị parallel.
l-e-h3-b03-33.s.s2.model.0: A kwesịrị ekwesị karịa n'ihi na isiokwu atọ niile bụ nouns dabara, ya mere ha bụ parallel.
l-e-h3-b03-33.s.s2.model.1: What Went Wrong na Solving It nwere udi dị iche, ya mere m na-ekpe ikpe na A ka mma.

l-e-h3-b03-34.title: Idetu nke mbụ megide ịchịkọta ya
l-e-h3-b03-34.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ nke ime ka otu ahịrịokwu nke mbụ dị mkpụmkpụ, họrọ nke ka mma, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara gị.
l-e-h3-b03-34.material: Nke mbụ: "Because the lake froze early this winter, the ice-fishing season began two weeks sooner than usual, and shops reported record sales of bait." Nchịkọta A na-edetu ahịrịokwu a dị ka ọ dị. Nchịkọta B bụ "An early freeze started ice-fishing sooner and boosted bait sales."
l-e-h3-b03-34.s.s1.o.a: A, n'ihi na ọ bụ nke mbụ kpọmkwem, ya mere ọ nweghị ike ịbụ nke ezighị ezi
l-e-h3-b03-34.s.s1.o.b: A, n'ihi na ọ nwere ọtụtụ okwu
l-e-h3-b03-34.s.s1.o.c: B, n'ihi na ọ na-edebe ihe pụtara ma na-eme ya dị mkpụmkpụ
l-e-h3-b03-34.s.s1.explain: B na-ejide n'ụzọ dị mkpụmkpụ isi ihe: nkwụsị oyi n'oge, oge ịkụ azụ n'oge, na mmụba nke ire bait. A adịghị mkpụmkpụ.
l-e-h3-b03-34.s.s2.model.0: B bụ nchịkọta n'ihi na ọ na-eme isi ihe dị mkpụmkpụ, ma A abụghị nchịkọta n'ihi na ọ na-edetu nke mbụ.
l-e-h3-b03-34.s.s2.model.1: A na-edebe ogologo nke mbụ, ya mere B, nke na-eme ya dị mkpụmkpụ ma na-edebe ihe pụtara, bụ nchịkọta ka mma.

l-e-h3-b03-35.title: Kedu n'ime ọbẹ ndị abụọ ahụ na-ewere ọrụ?
l-e-h3-b03-35.goal: Tụnyere ahịrịokwu abụọ na-arịọ ọbẹ maka ịbịa ọ gafere oge, họrọ nke ka mma, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara gị.
l-e-h3-b03-35.material: Nke a bụ ọbẹ sitere n'onye bịara ọ gafere oge maka nkwekọrịta. Ahịrịokwu A: "Sorry you feel that way." Ahịrịokwu B: "I'm sorry I was late."
l-e-h3-b03-35.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọbẹ nwere eziokwu karịa, ma gịnị mere?
l-e-h3-b03-35.s.s1.o.a: A, n'ihi na ọ na-ekwu banyere mmetụta onye ọzọ
l-e-h3-b03-35.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-atụkwasị mmetụta onye ọzọ ụta.
l-e-h3-b03-35.s.s1.o.b: B, n'ihi na ọ na-ekwu njehie nke onwe ozugbo
l-e-h3-b03-35.s.s1.r.c: Ịdị mkpụmkpụ anaghị eme ka ọ nwee eziokwu karịa.
l-e-h3-b03-35.s.s1.r.d: Ọdịiche bụ ma ọ na-anabata njehie.
l-e-h3-b03-35.s.s1.explain: B na-anabata njehie nke ịbịa ọ gafere oge. A na-ada ka ọ bụ na mmetụta nke onye ọzọ dị otú ahụ bụ nsogbu.
l-e-h3-b03-35.s.s2.model.0: B na-anabata na ọ bịara ọ gafere oge, ya mere ọ bụ ọbẹ na-ewere ọrụ ma nwee eziokwu karịa.

l-e-h3-b04-31.title: Ngwaa na-eso mistake
l-e-h3-b04-31.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara ngwaa na-ejikọta na mistake, họrọ nke kwesịrị ekwesị karị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara.
l-e-h3-b04-31.material: Ndị a bụ ahịrị okwu ụmụ akwụkwọ abụọ dere. A: I did a big mistake on the form. B: I made a big mistake on the form.
l-e-h3-b04-31.s.s1.o.a: A: Do bụ ngwaa a na-ejikarị, ya mere ọ ziri ezi
l-e-h3-b04-31.s.s1.r.a: Ngwaa a na-ejikarị anaghị ejikọta na aha niile.
l-e-h3-b04-31.s.s1.o.b: B: Make bụ onye mmekọ edoziri nke mistake
l-e-h3-b04-31.s.s1.o.c: Ha abụọ pụtara otu ihe, ya mere ha abụọ ziri ezi otu ahụ
l-e-h3-b04-31.s.s1.r.c: Ọbụna ma a ghọtara ihe ọ pụtara, make a mistake bụ naanị ụzọ okike.
l-e-h3-b04-31.s.s1.o.d: A: E mere ihe, ya mere do ziri ezi
l-e-h3-b04-31.s.s1.r.d: Ị naghị eji do naanị n'ihi na ọ bụ omume.
l-e-h3-b04-31.s.s1.explain: Mistake bụ onye mmekọ edoziri nke make. Do a mistake nwere ike ịghọta, ma ọ bụghị ihe okike.
l-e-h3-b04-31.s.s2.model.0: Mistake bụ onye mmekọ edoziri nke make, ya mere B kwesịrị ekwesị karị.
l-e-h3-b04-31.s.s2.model.1: Make a mistake bụ okwu okike, ya mere ahịrị okwu B ziri ezi.

l-e-h3-b04-32.material: (1) Anụmanụ na-eji ụzọ amamihe chọta nri. (2) Ndanda na-agbaso otu ụzọ ugboro ugboro. (3) Ugoloọma na-atụba mkpụrụ n’okporo ụzọ. Ahịrịokwu a ga-etinye: Isi ísì ha na-edu ndanda ndị ọzọ.
l-e-h3-b04-32.s.s1.prompt: Ebee ka ọ kacha dabara, gịnịkwa mere?
l-e-h3-b04-32.s.s1.o.a: Mgbe (3) gasịrị: ọ kacha mma itinye ya na njedebe ederede.
l-e-h3-b04-32.s.s1.r.a: Mgbe (3) gasịrị, Their ga-ezo aka n’ugoloọma.
l-e-h3-b04-32.s.s1.o.b: Mgbe (1) gasịrị: nkọwa n’ozuzu na-abịa mbụ n’isi.
l-e-h3-b04-32.s.s1.o.c: Mgbe (2) gasịrị: Their na-ezo aka na ndanda dị na (2).
l-e-h3-b04-32.s.s1.o.d: Ihe ọ pụtara bụ otu n’ebe ọ bụla.
l-e-h3-b04-32.s.s1.r.d: Ihe Their na-ezo aka na ya na-agbanwe dabere n’ebe e tinyere ya.
l-e-h3-b04-32.s.s1.explain: Their na-ezo aka na ndanda, “ndanda ndị ọzọ” esochie ya; ya mere o kwesịrị ịbịa ozugbo (2) gachara, ebe ndanda pụtara.
l-e-h3-b04-32.s.s2.model.0: Their na-ezo aka na ndanda dị na (2); ya mere tinye ya mgbe (2) gasịrị ka ederede jikọọ nke ọma.

l-e-h3-b06-35.s.s1.r.b: Ngọpụ na-eme ka ọ dị ka mmadụ anabataghị nsogbu onye ahịa nwere.

l-e-h3-b07-06.s.s1.r.a: Admitted na-ebu ikpe na onye ahụ nabatara ya n'enweghị ọchịchọ.

l-e-h3-b07-06.s.s1.r.c: Verb mkpesa ọ bụla na-ebu àgwà dị iche.
l-e-h3-b07-06.s.s1.o.d: P: Ka verb siri ike, ka ọ na-ekwere akụkụ karịa
l-e-h3-b07-06.s.s1.r.d: Verb siri ike n'ezie na-agbakwunye àgwà onye nta akụkọ.

l-e-h3-b01-38.material: Klọb akwụkwọ chọrọ isiokwu poster na-ekwu na ọ na-agụ, na-ede, ma na-ekekọrịta. Ọnọdụ: gụnye omume atọ niile, mee ka ihe ndị ahụ bụrụ parallel, ma jiri okwu 4 ma ọ bụ ihe erughị.

l-e-h3-b01-39.material: Ị na-emechi email nye onye nnọchiteanya ụlọ ọrụ. Ọnọdụ: nwee nsọpụrụ, kwupụta na ịchọrọ azịza ngwa ngwa, ma jiri otu ahịrịokwu.

l-e-h3-b01-40.title: Kedu kaadị iwu dị mkpụmkpụ mana na-ahapụghị ihe ọ bụla?
l-e-h3-b01-40.goal: N'ide kaadị iwu maka egwuregwu bọọdụ, tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha kwesị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara.
l-e-h3-b01-40.material: Ị ga-ede iwu ndị ahụ n'otu kaadị. Ọnọdụ: n'ime ahịrị 3, gụnye ma nhazi ma usoro ihe a ga-eme, ma gosi usoro site n'ọnụọgụ.
l-e-h3-b01-40.s.s1.r.a: Ọ nweghị usoro ma ọ nweghị nhazi.
l-e-h3-b01-40.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-edepụta ihe n'enweghị ọnụọgụ, ya mere usoro adịghị doo anya.
l-e-h3-b01-40.s.s1.r.d: Ọ naghị agwụ ma e gbatịrị ya ogologo.
l-e-h3-b01-40.s.s1.explain: 1 Deal five cards. 2 Roll. 3 Move. na-egosi nhazi na usoro site n'ọnụọgụ, n'ụzọ dị mkpụmkpụ.
l-e-h3-b01-40.s.s2.model.0: Ọ na-egosi usoro site n'ọnụọgụ, nwee nhazi (ịkesa kaadị), ma dị mkpụmkpụ, ya mere ọ dabara n'ime ahịrị 3.
l-e-h3-b01-40.s.s2.model.1: Ọ na-etinye naanị otu omume n'ọnụọgụ ọ bụla ma gụnyekwa nhazi, ya mere ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ niile.

l-e-h3-b02-36.title: Kedu okwu bụ eziokwu ma na-ada mma nakwa?
l-e-h3-b02-36.goal: N'okwu na-ewepụta ụlọ nwere mita square 12, tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegide ibe ha, họrọ nkwekọrịta kwesịrị ekwesị kacha, ma kọwaa ihe mere.
l-e-h3-b02-36.material: Mgbasa ozi na-ewepụta ụlọ nwere mita square 12. Ọnọdụ: ọ ga-abụrịrị eziokwu na-enweghị ihe ụgha, ọ ga-enyerịrị mmetụta ọma, ma ọ ga-abụrịrị Bekee nkịtị.
l-e-h3-b02-36.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ eziokwu, ma ọ naghị enye mmetụta ọma.
l-e-h3-b02-36.s.s1.r.c: Ọ dị iche na eziokwu, ya mere ọ bụghị eziokwu.
l-e-h3-b02-36.s.s1.r.d: Ịkpọ obere ụlọ ka ọ sara mbara abụghị eziokwu.
l-e-h3-b02-36.s.s1.explain: Cozy na compact na-anabata eziokwu na ụlọ dị obere ma na-enye mmetụta ọma. Ha bụkwa okwu a na-ejikarị n'asụsụ Bekee.
l-e-h3-b02-36.s.s2.model.0: A cozy, compact room na-ekwu na ụlọ dị obere ma na-ada mma nakwa, ya mere ọ kwekọrọ n'ọnọdụ ndị ahụ.
l-e-h3-b02-36.s.s2.model.1: Spacious bụ ụgha n'ihi na ọ naghị adaba n'eziokwu, ma cramped bụ nke ọjọọ, ya mere cozy, compact na-emezu ọnọdụ niile.

l-e-h3-b03-37.goal: Ịhọrọ ahịrịokwu maka ntụziaka ọrụ aka ụmụaka: tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-adọta megide ibe ha, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha kwesị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara.
l-e-h3-b03-37.material: Nke a bụ otu ahịrịokwu sitere n'ntụziaka ọrụ aka ụmụaka. Ọnọdụ: jiri okwu dị mfe, gbochie nwa ka ọ ghara iji ngwá ọrụ dị nkọ naanị ya, ma gụnye ihe ịkpụ akwụkwọ pụtara.
l-e-h3-b03-37.s.s1.r.b: Ọ dị ize ndụ, ya mere ọ bụghị nke dị nchebe.
l-e-h3-b03-37.s.s1.r.c: Ị nweghị ike ịmata ihe ị ga-akpụ.
l-e-h3-b03-37.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-ahapụ nwa ka ọ jiri ngwá ọrụ dị nkọ naanị ya.
l-e-h3-b03-37.s.s1.explain: Ịrịọ onye toro eto ka o mee ịkpụ dị nchebe, ma ọ na-eji okwu dị mfe gụnye ịkpụ akwụkwọ.
l-e-h3-b03-37.s.s2.model.0: Ask an adult na-edebe nchekwa, cut the paper na-enye ihe ịkpụ pụtara, ma okwu ndị ahụ dị mfe, ya mere ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ ndị ahụ.
